new.name: stardust
new.brief: A light being in a small humanoid form of clear glass — not a woman in white; faceted, refracting, a little light moving inside; no face detail beyond the suggestion of one. Three states: blanket of light, glass figure, fading.

new.name: lucille
new.brief: A demon crouched on four limbs and a head, features a distorted mockery of a man, hollow eyes blacker than the dark, teeth hidden; second state: the same figure wearing a spirit woman's face.

new.name: viola
new.brief: The singer at the Wind Caves, hands out, lantern-lit from below.

new.name: vothek
new.brief: The storyteller: a man with a serious face and playful eyes, on a small stage by a rock wall, firelight.

new.name: matteo
new.brief: A young man (rendered as 18+) with long brown hair whipped by storm wind, bare feet on sacred sand; second state: kneeling in the Outer Darkness as 'Conqueror'.

new.name: venetia
new.brief: The Prison of Voids: a woman who becomes a panther with wrong angles; both states on one sheet; a smell of decay you can see in the air around her.

new.name: morningstar
new.brief: The master of the Outer Darkness: tall, still, lit only by what others give off; no horns, no cliché — a figure whose stillness is the threat.

new.name: abyss-of-four-waterfalls
new.brief: A drained, colourless land centred on an abyss darker than black; four waterfalls pour in from pure sources on the rim; everything around it dead. Three views: from the air, from the rim, from inside facing one waterfall.

new.name: cloud-mountain
new.brief: A mountain peak above a crater lake that reflects the whole mountain (Mirror Lake), dawn mist — the place Episode 1 ended.

new.name: lake-of-light
new.brief: Translucent water with suspended limestone motes and glowing insects (blue-green), trees anchored in the lake with high roots, a small stage against the rock wall of the North Hills; moonlight. Views: from the trees, from the water, from under it.

new.name: old-lands
new.brief: The ancient world of the Angel Killer legend, day, painted light, a bare rock — warmer and softer than the rest of the film.

new.name: leviticum-exterior
new.brief: A seven-floor circular library of stone and glass above the forest, candles in every window, steps up to main doors with a band of gold inscription (illegible) above them.

new.name: leviticum-study-room
new.brief: A small study room: foam mattresses, books, a glisc projector throwing constellations on the ceiling, very low light.

new.name: leviticum-elevator
new.brief: A glass elevator in a stone shaft; a glowing green call button; numbered buttons where only the 1 glows; the seventh-floor hall beyond the doors, dark.

new.name: leviticum-corridor
new.brief: The ground-floor corridor, lantern-lit, a passage at the end.

new.name: ilan-storm
new.brief: A hidden island at night as a storm tears it apart: sacred sand, a blackened tree, a giant glowing beast in the sky; two lights in the sky, violet and emerald.

new.name: outer-darkness
new.brief: A place with no light; a ring of twelve kneeling figures; the only light is what the bodies and the Stone give off.

new.name: glisc-projector
new.brief: A floor-set projector that throws shifting constellations on a ceiling.

new.name: heart-of-ilan
new.brief: A jagged, unrefined emerald stone, glowing from inside; also seen buried inches in sand.

new.name: fx-dark-cloud
new.brief: A massive cloud of darkness over a land; it collapses in on itself when the light comes.

new.name: fx-light-wave
new.brief: Light moving as an ocean wave: cresting over a lip of rock and pouring down over dead land, colour returning in its wake.

new.name: fx-wind
new.brief: A strong wind as it is seen: lantern flames leaning, hair and cloth lifting, dust lifting off a floor.

new.name: fx-pillar-of-fire
new.brief: A pillar of fire descending onto a rock in daylight, painted-light style.

this._: Reused by id from Episode 1, not duplicated: a Soul is one trained identity and cannot be copied. The same face plays the Episode 2 part. Souls run only on Soul 2.0 and Soul Cinematic (soul_id); every Cinema Studio shot uses the element of the same name instead. Sadie is the first Soul made for Episode 2.

sadie.status: trained Oct 5 from five images: the sheet and four portraits
